The '''Scion shuttle''' was the custom [[starship]] used by [[witch]] [[Morgan Elsbeth]] as a [[transport]] and private [[shuttle]].<ref name="Part 2" /> In around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{AhsokaSeriesDate}}</ref> Elsbeth used the ship to travel to the [[planet]] [[Seatos]], where [[Baylan Skoll]] believed he had discovered the [[Seatos reflex point|reflex point]] to the [[Pathway to Peridea|Pathway]] to [[Peridea]] to travel to [[Far galaxy|another galaxy]] and rescue [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] from his [[Exile (punishment)|exile]].<ref name="Part 2" /> She later used the same ship to commute to and from the [[hyperspace transport ring]] ''[[Eye of Sion]]'' to prepare it for departure, and later to finally board it for the [[extragalactic]] journey.<ref name="Part 4">{{Ahsoka|Part Four: Fallen Jedi}}</ref> The ship was [[gold]]-[[color]]ed and was equipped with two [[stabilizer]]s, one on each side.<ref name="Part 2" />
